test_title: PYST 58: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Kamal is not willing to purchase a house on the 12th floor of a sea-side apartment, as she is fearful of heights. She is suffering from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**acrophobia**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**acrophobia**" means an extreme or irrational fear of heights.
 
• Kamal is not willing to purchase a house on the 12th floor because she is fearful of heights.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Kamal is not willing to purchase a house on the 12th floor of a sea-side apartment, as she is fearful of heights. She is suffering from acrophobia__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heliophobia**: means an extreme or irrational fear of sunlight.
 
• **Claustrophobia**: means an extreme or irrational fear of confined places.
 
• **Sociophobia**: means an extreme or irrational fear of social situations or interactions.
